draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 163rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 20th of 28 at WR. He went 99th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (163rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Zay Jones. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (2nd percentile), 10-yard split (7th percentile). College production: 1,286 receiving yards in 2021, 5th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: inactive. Last NFL action came in 2024. 32 career games and 6 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2024.
